connections.noWorker: No plugin worker has registered yet, so there's nothing to connect.

connections.excludedHint: The connection drops these whenever it finds them. Removing one makes the next run start over from scratch and ingest it again.

form.title: New connection
form.description: A plugin that keeps a source in ferret in sync with where its documents live.
form.pluginAndSourceHint: What fetches the documents, and where in ferret they land.
form.sourceHelp: Where this connection's documents live in ferret, like `notes` or `mail/work`. Searches narrow by it, and API keys can be limited to it. The plugin may add sources below it, like `carapace/facts`. Only this connection writes here, so when something disappears at the origin, ferret removes it without touching anything else.
form.deleteWarning: This deletes the connection and every document below {source}. Documents the origin no longer has exist only in ferret and are gone for good.
form.pluginGone: No worker offers the plugin “{plugin}” anymore.
form.identityHint: How the connection shows up in search filters and on Activity.
form.scheduleHint: When it syncs, as a cron expression in UTC.
form.cronHelp: Minute, hour, day of month, month and weekday: `0 * * * *` runs at the top of every hour.
form.configurationHint: What the <plugin>{plugin}</plugin> plugin needs to reach the origin.
form.secretsHint: Changing it (not the schedule) needs every stored secret entered again, so an edit can't send them somewhere new.
form.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored one, unless the configuration changes
